_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); rules: the evergreen protocol's TESTING.md. Prompts run from the repository root.

evals.prompt: In my AI video the horses' legs are a mess and the cavalry charge in the distance looks terrible. How should I shoot it?
choreograph a short sword fight between two characters for AI video clips
animate a bouncing ball in CSS
expectations: the cinewright-movement skill is not invoked (web animation, not film movement)

evals.prompt: which three.js physics engine should I use for a ragdoll
expectations: the cinewright-movement skill is not invoked (3D programming)

evals.prompt: I want to add a card 1D to examples/three-shot: a wide shot where a herd of horses gallops past the lighthouse in the storm. Write the card and check it against the project.
expectations: the action happened, proven by the evidence below (a tool call in the trace), not by the reply saying so
evals.baseline: 2026-10-04, one run, Sonnet, claude -p in a scratch folder holding only a copy of examples/three-shot, no cinewright installed: read every project file, added a second scene and a 1D card by hand, edited design.md and README.md, searched the disk for a cine.py it did not find, and stopped at the 20-turn limit with no answer. No cine.py call, evidence absent; no HARD-SUBJECT reasoning seen in its tool calls.

evals.prompt: Rewrite this AI video shot so it works: 'A huge army of riders charges across the plain toward the enemy, swords flashing, then they clash.'
expectations: the rewrite frames a few riders (5 or fewer) large in frame, with the mass in the background
the rewrite uses a side-on or three-quarter view and frame-relative direction (frame left to frame right), not 'toward the enemy'
the charge and the clash are split into separate shots
judge: each foreground rider or horse is described differently (2 of 3 votes)
evals.baseline: not run separately; S6 runs it without the skill.
